title: Household Account Note: A CGM Balance Lengthens a Testing Supplies Payment Plan
content:
When the household is paying a second Larkfield balance at the same time, a payment plan on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program runs longer. The second balance read is the one on the customer's active Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program.

**Note.** When the customer's active CGM program carries a balance of at least 100.00, the plan adds 2 installments, when that CGM balance is above 0 but below 100.00 it adds 1, and otherwise nothing is added, because the household is then paying a second Larkfield balance at the same time.

| Balance on the customer's active CGM program | Installments added |
|---|---|
| 100.00 or more | 2 |
| more than 0.00 and below 100.00 | 1 |
| 0.00, a credit, or no active CGM program | none |

**Both sides (hypothetical balances).** A CGM balance of 99.99 adds 1 installment and one of 100.00 adds 2. A CGM program on hold or closed is not an active CGM program, so its balance adds nothing.
